about.page_subtitle: AI-powered CV optimization system & career tools connector
about.about_p1: SmartCV is an AI-powered CV optimization platform that helps users create, improve, and manage professional resumes. Our system uses artificial intelligence to enhance CV structure, rewrite content professionally, and optimize documents for ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems).
about.about_p2: Beyond CV creation, SmartCV connects users to a curated ecosystem of external career tools — including job search platforms, AI interview coaches, and labor market analytics — empowering users to prepare comprehensively for their career journey.
about.about_note_body: SmartCV is NOT a job board, recruitment platform, or employment agency. We do not provide jobs, match candidates with employers, or facilitate hiring. We exclusively support users through AI-powered CV tools and connections to third-party career platforms.
about.terms_1: Users are fully responsible for the accuracy and truthfulness of all content in their CVs. SmartCV provides AI-powered suggestions but does not verify claims.
about.terms_2: AI features are assistive tools only. SmartCV does not guarantee employment, interview invitations, or any specific outcomes from using our platform.
about.terms_3: External links and third-party tools (job platforms, interview coaches, market analytics) are owned and operated by their respective companies. SmartCV is not responsible for their content or services.
about.terms_4: SmartCV reserves the right to modify, update, or discontinue features at any time. Users will be notified of significant changes when possible.
about.terms_5: Misuse of the platform — including generating fraudulent content, abusing AI features, or violating intellectual property rights — is strictly prohibited and may result in account termination.
about.privacy_1: All CV data and personal information are stored securely using industry-standard encryption and security practices.
about.privacy_2: We do not sell, share, or distribute user data to third parties. Your information is used exclusively for CV generation and AI-powered features within SmartCV.
about.privacy_3: Users can delete their data and account at any time. Upon deletion, all associated CV data is permanently removed from our systems.
about.privacy_4: Data is used solely for providing CV optimization, AI assistance, and platform functionality. We do not use your data for advertising or profiling purposes.
about.faq_a1: SmartCV is an AI-powered CV optimization platform that helps users create, improve, and manage their resumes while connecting them to external career tools for job search, interview preparation, and market insights.
about.faq_a2: No. SmartCV does NOT provide jobs or act as a recruitment platform. Instead, it helps users prepare better CVs and connects them to third-party platforms for job search and career preparation.
about.faq_a3: No. SmartCV is NOT a job board. It is a CV optimization system and career tools ecosystem connector. We help you build better CVs and link you to external resources.
about.faq_a4: AI is used to improve CV structure, rewrite content professionally, optimize for ATS systems, and suggest better wording. AI does NOT apply for jobs or contact employers on your behalf.
about.faq_a5: Yes. Users can export their CV as a PDF, preview it before downloading, and edit it at any time from their workspace.
about.faq_a6: Yes. All CV data is securely stored, never shared with third parties, and users can delete their data at any time.
about.faq_q7: Does SmartCV help me find jobs?
about.faq_a7: Indirectly. SmartCV connects users to external platforms such as job search tools, AI interview coaches, and labor market analytics. We do not host job listings ourselves.
about.faq_a8: Yes. SmartCV supports both English and Vietnamese. You can switch languages at any time using the language switcher in the navigation bar.
about.faq_a9: Yes. Full account and data deletion is supported. Upon deletion, all your CV data is permanently removed from our systems.
